Disposal Bin Rental FAQs

Have questions about disposal bin rentals? Find answers below about rental periods, pricing, loading requirements, prohibited materials, delivery, pickup, and booking with Ridgeway Rentals.

1. General

A disposal bin is a bin that we deliver directly to your home, business, or project site. You load the bin at your own pace, and when you're finished, we pick it up and take care of the disposal.

Choose your preferred rental dates, submit a request, and we'll confirm availability with you. Once your rental is confirmed, we'll deliver the disposal bin to your location. You fill it at your own pace, and we'll come back to pick it up when you're done.

We recommend requesting your disposal bin as early as possible, especially for weekends and busy periods. Last-minute requests may be available depending on availability.

No. Submitting a request does not guarantee availability or confirm your rental. A member of the Ridgeway Rentals team will review your requested dates and disposal bin availability and contact you to confirm your rental.

2. Disposal Bin Size & Loading

We currently offer one disposal bin size: 5 × 8.5 ft. It is suitable for household cleanouts, renovations, construction projects, landscaping, and other disposal needs.

The standard rental includes up to 500 kg of disposal weight. Material exceeding 500 kg is subject to an additional charge of $2 per kilogram.

The standard rental includes disposal of up to 500 kg of material. Additional weight is charged at $2 per kilogram over the included 500 kg allowance. The disposal facility's measured weight will be used to determine the disposal weight where applicable.

No. All materials must remain completely inside the disposal bin. Nothing may extend above the top edge or hang over the sides, front, or rear. The load must also be reasonably level and evenly distributed.

Materials must remain completely inside the disposal bin. The load should be reasonably level and evenly distributed, with no material extending above the top edge or hanging over the sides, front, or rear. The disposal bin doors must also be able to completely close and securely latch before pickup.

3. What Can I Put in the Disposal Bin?

Certain materials are strictly prohibited, including tires, asbestos, hazardous materials, fuels, propane or compressed gas cylinders, paint and solvents, automotive fluids, pesticides, hazardous batteries, medical or biomedical waste, liquid waste, hot ashes or coals, burning or smouldering materials, animal carcasses, and other materials prohibited by the receiving disposal facility or applicable law.

For the complete list of prohibited materials, please review our Terms & Conditions.

Not sure if something is permitted? Contact us before placing it in the disposal bin.

Furniture may be placed in the disposal bin as long as it does not contain prohibited materials and is loaded safely within the disposal bin's weight and loading requirements.

Construction and renovation debris can be placed in the disposal bin, provided the materials comply with our Terms & Conditions and are loaded safely. Concrete, soil, dirt, roofing shingles, and similar heavy materials require advance notification and must be loaded according to Ridgeway Rentals' instructions.

Yes, but Ridgeway Rentals must be notified before any concrete, soil, dirt, roofing shingles, or similar heavy materials are placed in the disposal bin. These materials must be kept separate from other waste and loaded according to Ridgeway Rentals' instructions.

4. Delivery

The disposal bin must be placed in a safe, firm, level, and accessible location. We will make reasonable efforts to place it where requested, but the driver has final discretion based on safety, accessibility, ground conditions, overhead clearances, and the ability to safely retrieve the loaded disposal bin.

Call or email Ridgeway Rentals to coordinate delivery arrangements. We'll work with you to confirm the delivery location and any instructions needed for access and placement.

Please allow approximately 8 ft wide by 15 ft long for access. The delivery area must also be safe, firm, level, and accessible, with sufficient clearance for the truck to safely deliver and retrieve the disposal bin.

Yes. We can deliver to residential, commercial, and project locations where access and placement are suitable.

5. Rental Period & Pickup

The standard rental period is up to 7 days from the date of delivery.

Yes, extensions may be available at $50 per additional day, subject to disposal bin availability. Contact Ridgeway Rentals before the end of your rental period if you need additional time. Extensions are not guaranteed.

Once you're finished, we'll pick up the disposal bin on the scheduled pickup date. If you finish early, call or email Ridgeway Rentals to arrange an earlier pickup.

Yes. Early pickup is available at the same cost as the standard rental rate. Call or email Ridgeway Rentals to arrange an earlier pickup.

The disposal bin must be safely accessible on the scheduled pickup date. A $50 failed pickup fee may apply if Ridgeway Rentals is unable to retrieve the disposal bin because of circumstances within the Renter's control, such as blocked access, an overloaded or improperly loaded bin, prohibited materials, or unsafe site conditions.

6. Pricing

The standard rental fee is $395 plus applicable taxes. The standard rental period is up to 7 days and includes disposal of up to 500 kg of material.

Yes. The standard rental fee includes disposal of up to 500 kg of material. Additional weight is charged at $2 per kilogram over the included 500 kg allowance.

Additional charges may apply in certain circumstances, including:

  • $50 per additional rental day beyond the standard 7-day period
  • $2 per kilogram over the included 500 kg disposal allowance
  • $250 for an additional dump trip during the rental period
  • A minimum $200 prohibited-item fee, plus applicable handling or disposal costs
  • A $50 failed pickup fee when Ridgeway Rentals is unable to safely retrieve the disposal bin due to circumstances within the Renter's control

Applicable taxes will be added where required.

The standard rental service includes delivery and pickup. Contact Ridgeway Rentals if you have questions about delivery to your location or special access requirements.

You can request a replacement disposal bin if you need another dump during your rental period. Each additional dump trip is $250.

7. Booking

Use the Request a Disposal Bin form on our website. Select your preferred disposal bin, drop-off date, and pickup date, then provide your contact and delivery information. We'll review availability and contact you to confirm your rental.

Yes. You can select your preferred drop-off date when submitting your request. We'll review availability and contact you to confirm your rental and delivery details.

Weekend rentals may be available depending on scheduling and availability. Call or email Ridgeway Rentals to check availability. Weekend availability is not guaranteed.

Same-day delivery may be available depending on scheduling and availability. Call us at 365-925-0155 or email us to check availability. Same-day delivery is not guaranteed.

We'll contact you to discuss alternative dates or other options that may work for your project. We will do our best to accommodate your requested dates based on availability.

8. Service Area

We serve Hamilton, Waterdown, Flamborough, Burlington, Oakville, Ancaster, Dundas, Stoney Creek, Milton, Mississauga, and Etobicoke. We may also be able to accommodate locations outside our standard service area depending on the project and location. Contact us with your address to confirm availability.

We may be able to accommodate locations outside our standard service area depending on the location and project. Contact us with your address and we'll confirm whether service is available and whether any additional charges apply.
